_note: The entire surface a product team may set. Six fields.
That number is the answer to spec question 1: one calculation serves five
consumers without 'a parameter surface so wide that every consumer configures
a different calculation', because the consumer-facing surface is SIX FIELDS
and the other ~40 tunables are not merely discouraged -- they are not
emitted into this file and are rejected if written into it.
A product team that needs a seventh field files a request against
credit-core. That is friction, and it is the right friction: every previous
widening of an interface started with somebody adding one field quietly.

_rejected_examples._note: Written here as documentation of what this file cannot contain. Each is a real error message.
_rejected_examples.expenses.absolute_ceiling_cents: owner_class=policy. Owned by credit_risk_policy. Ask them.
_rejected_examples.deductions.paye_table_override: owner_class=statutory. Owned by credit_systems, transcribing the gazette. Unreachable from a product configuration.
_rejected_examples.capacity.buffer_grid_name: profile-bound. Set by the assessment mode (policy/modes.py), not by a product.
_rejected_examples.steps: composition key. `resolve_params` rejects any document carrying `use`, `type`, `steps`, `arms` or `modifies` (doc 08 2.1).
